skills.name: Soothing Spores
skills.description:
Seed a large area of mushrooms in front of you, healing you and your allies for |cffffff3380|r Health.

Heals for |cffffff15|r% more on allies that are within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

skills.name: Necrotic Orb
skills.description:
Project a globe of annihilation that slowly floats forward for |cffffff10|r seconds, dealing |cffffff352|r Magic Damage every |cffffff1|r second to nearby enemies. 

An ally near the globe can activate the Combustion synergy, causing the orb to explode for |cffffff2560|r Magic Damage to nearby enemies and restore |cffffff3960|r Magicka or Stamina to the ally, whichever maximum is higher.

skills.name: Spiked Bone Shield
skills.description:
Surround yourself with a whirlwind of bones, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff20270|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds and returns |cffffff95|r% of direct damage absorbed back to the enemy. This ability scales off your Max Health.

An ally near you can activate the Bone Wall synergy, granting the ally and up to |cffffff5|r other allies a damage shield equal to |cffffff30|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff6|r seconds.

skills.name: Healing Seed
skills.description:
Sprout a field of flowers which blooms after |cffffff6|r seconds, healing you and allies in the area for |cffffff4364|r Health.

An ally within the field can activate the Harvest synergy, healing for |cffffff3834|r Health over |cffffff5|r seconds.

skills.name: Ravenous Goliath
skills.description:
Become a horrific Ravenous Goliath, increasing your Max Health by |cffffff30000|r for |cffffff20|r seconds and immediately restoring |cffffff30000|r Health. You cannot conceal your presence while active.

While transformed, your damaging Light Attacks restore |cffffff1308|r Health and fully-charged Heavy Attacks restore |cffffff3270|r Health. You deal |cffffff3377|r Magic Damage to nearby enemies every second and heal for that amount. These abilities scale off your Max Health.
